verdict.rationale: Muse lets you review what it has done and plans to do through a complete audit trail and activity log. You can inspect and edit the files and tools it generates in its VM, and manage goals from the Goals tab. For rollback, the only evidence is continuous VM backups that can be restored 'if something goes wrong', which is coarse disaster recovery rather than per-automation rollback, and nothing shows explicit versioning of automations. Missing for 10: explicit versioning or history of automations, per-automation rollback to prior versions, a diff or change review before an automation update takes effect, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
